domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Domains or URLs (https://www.example.com/page works too). Internationalised domains are supported.

whois.title: Registration (WHOIS/RDAP)
whois.description: Registrar, creation/update/expiry dates, days until expiry, status, nameservers, DNSSEC; unregistered domains are marked registered: false.

dns.title: DNS records
dns.description: A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, CAA, SOA plus parsed SPF and DMARC.

ssl.title: SSL certificate
ssl.description: Issuer, subject, alternative names, valid from/to, days left, whether the certificate is trusted, TLS version.
